name: Kasuga Tamaki
source: Tamaki Kasuga is the main protagonist of Hiiro no Kakera. She is a cheerful girl with a gentle nature. She is the only one who can seal the Onikirimaru, since she has the blood of the Tamayori Princess coursing through her veins.
